findings.title: Sensor Gap Advisor prices a hot-water tank thermometer as the top gap on installs with no hot water
findings.claim: On every matrix cell whose payload says dhw_enabled is False, once a power series exists SensorGapAdvisorSensor publishes dhw_temp_entity as its top gap with a positive monthly cost (12 of 22 no-DHW cell-cycles), because _gap_probe_terms prices a month of the default tank volume whether or not hot water is configured.
findings.mechanism: sensor._gap_probe_terms sets dhw_extra_kwh from EntryConfig.dhw_tank_volume, which falls back to DEFAULT_DHW_TANK_VOLUME when no tank is configured; topology.rank_sensor_gaps prices the dhw_temp_entity row whenever that key is unset, with no DHW-enabled gate. The plan sensors gate their DHW attributes on the payload's dhw_enabled (round-5 D12-01, #1237); the gap advisor decides the same fact without it. The entity is enabled by default and the card's advisor page reads it (heatpump-optimizer-card.js advisorRow(plan, "gap", ...)).

evidence.unit: cell-cycles (of 22 no-DHW cell-cycles) publishing a priced dhw_temp_entity gap; all 12 have it as top_slot and state
evidence.contention_note: shared box with other finder seats running; the count is deterministic (frozen clock, injected prices, no network); this run's load1 line was filtered, nearest run 207.89

perturbation.change: --fix: _gap_probe_terms returns dhw_extra_kwh 0.0 when thermal_model._dhw_enabled_from_config(config) is false (in memory)

findings.metric_definition: count of (cell, cycle) pairs with payload dhw_enabled False where SensorGapAdvisorSensor publishes a dhw_temp_entity gap with sek_per_month > 0
findings.phenomenon_property: An advisor gap is priced only for a slot whose feature is configured: no slot of a disabled feature carries a positive monthly cost or becomes the advisor's state.
findings.seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D8/s1/gapdhw.py -v (and every row of topology.rank_sensor_gaps whose feature can be unconfigured; at baseline only dhw_temp_entity)

null_control.note: DHW-enabled cells without a tank probe keep their priced gap under the fix: there the gap is real

run with --fix: no_dhw_priced=0 and no_dhw_top=0, dhw_null unchanged
findings.proposed_fix_scope: gate the DHW coast term on the install's DHW status (sensor._gap_probe_terms or the dhw row of topology.rank_sensor_gaps)

findings.title: Plan Monthly Savings publishes the open month extrapolated from one settled interval (x2688 to x2976)
findings.claim: Through the production cycle, the first numeric state Plan Monthly Savings publishes in a new month is one settled 15-minute interval's saving multiplied by the coverage factor 2688 (Feb) / 2976 (Jan, install month), and the state swings by over 1700 in currency within the first hour (-1728.39, -1232.94, -1398.17, then 18.44).
findings.mechanism: ledger.MonthlyLedger.savings_months scales every open-month figure by ledger.coverage_factor = month_hours / settled_hours with no floor on settled hours; MonthlySavingsSensor._waiting_for only asks for a row to exist, so the sensor publishes the estimate from the first booked interval. The sensor is enabled by default and is the card's savings headline (statEntity("_plan_monthly_savings")).

evidence.unit: coverage factor applied to the first numeric state of the new month (ratio); swing over the first four numeric states 1728.39 currency
evidence.contention_note: shared box with other finder seats running; deterministic (frozen clock, injected prices and inputs, no network)

perturbation.change: --min-hours 24: MonthlySavingsSensor._waiting_for also waits until the open month has 24 settled hours (in memory)

findings.metric_definition: ledger.coverage_factor of the open month on the first cycle of the month whose MonthlySavingsSensor state is a number
findings.phenomenon_property: A published open-month money estimate is not extrapolated from a settled span too short to bound it: the multiplier applied to the settled figures stays bounded (no estimate before a minimum settled coverage).
findings.seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D8/s1/monthly.py -v (every published reader of ledger.coverage_factor-scaled open-month figures: grep -n coverage_factor custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py)

findings.proposed_fix_scope: a minimum settled coverage before the open month's estimate is published (sensor-side waiting_for or ledger-side), so the published multiplier is bounded

findings.title: Plan Monthly Savings is available with state unknown at a month rollover while settled months exist
findings.claim: At the first cycle of a new month (2026-02-01T00:00), MonthlySavingsSensor is available and publishes None (Home Assistant 'unknown') while savings_months carries the settled January row: 1 of 17 cycles across the rollover.
findings.mechanism: MonthlySavingsSensor._waiting_for returns None whenever any row exists, but native_value is a number only for the open month's estimated row with a non-None savings_sek. The two predicates disagree whenever the open month has no row yet (rollover, measured) or its row is withheld (old_basis / below_meter_floor, read from code, not measured). The _WaitsForEvidenceMixin's own contract is that 'not measured yet' is unavailable, never unknown.

evidence.unit: cycles (of 17, 2026-01-31T22:00 to 2026-02-01T02:00 UTC) with the sensor available and its state None
evidence.contention_note: shared box with other finder seats running; deterministic

perturbation.change: --gate-waiting: _waiting_for answers settled_savings_month unless an estimated row with a numeric savings_sek exists (in memory)

findings.metric_definition: count of cycles where MonthlySavingsSensor.available is True and native_value is None
findings.phenomenon_property: MonthlySavingsSensor is available exactly when its native_value can be a number: availability and value read the same row.
findings.seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D8/s1/monthly.py -v (seams: no open-month row; open-month row withheld by old_basis or below_meter_floor)
reproduction_steps: run the command: the 2026-02-01T00:00:00 line reads avail True state None rows ['2026-01']
findings.proposed_fix_scope: key MonthlySavingsSensor._waiting_for on the open month's estimated row with a numeric saving, the row native_value reads

leads.symbol: What to reuse, and what will trip you
leads.what: Trap not listed: HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._async_update_data solves in the process worker (coordinator._run_in_process), so an in-memory perturbation of optimizer.py moves nothing; extras.py had to route coordinator._run_in_process inline (lambda fn, args: fn(*args)) before --unscaled-divisor moved 0 -> 10.

The receipt/notifier readers of the open month (notifier.py reads savings_months) inherit the same unbounded month_hours/settled_hours multiplier D8-s1-02 measures on the sensor; owner of the ledger maths to confirm the floor belongs there.

The dhw_temp_entity row is priced with no DHW-enabled gate (D8-s1-01's seam on the topology side); the plan sensors' setup_topology/sensor_advisor attribute (_sensor_advisor_attribute) was not checked for the same gap.
